text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0586
BOE + BCA
CD 2
CONTRACT AWARD – VALLEY VILLAGE PARK STORMWATER CAPTURE PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
FIND Transmittal Nos. 2 and 4 to be unmerited, as discussed in this report;
RECEIVE and FILE Transmittal No. 3;
DECLARE American Integrated Services, Inc. (AIS), first low bidder, to be the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and AWARD AIS a contract for the Valley Village Park Stormwater Capture Project for $11,511,200; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the contract after approval as to form has been obtained from the City Attorney.
(W.O.: EW40085F)
summary: The Board of Public Works is asked to award American Integrated Services, Inc. an $11,511,200 contract to build a stormwater capture project at Valley Village Park in Council District 2. The Board would also find two of three contractor transmittals unmerited and receive and file the third.
